page.layout: Two parallel columns of index tables (Cap. | Vers. | Pag.) separated by a central rule, with the section letter "IN" at the lower right; the printed title "INDEX" at the top. Faint mirrored text from the reverse side is not transcribed.
page.notes: Faint show-through from the reverse side (mirrored and upside-down text, including the large "Rerum, & verborum, quae hoc in libro explicantur" and body text in the centre) is omitted. Some cap and verse numbers in the left column near Philip. and Colos. are doubtful, and the "1." beside 2 Timoth. and "14." in the last Apocal. line are uncertain. The running head "INDEX" is taken as printed at the top.
